name: Test: C# cost per frame when hosting
author: test
summary: Frame time and C# self time per hook on the host: alone, with a client, then with 60 SparklingBall projectiles and 15 ExampleCustomAISlimeNPC. The client measures its own frames. Also runs in singleplayer for the baseline.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csmpperf. Needs adb shell setprop debug.bl.cshookprofile 1 and ExampleModCSharp on. The client joins 127.0.0.1:7777 by itself from the title when Players/csmpperf.client exists. Logs csmpperf ... and csmpperf END.
